text:
The Jets were supposed to wobble after trading Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey on Oct. 23, ending the standoff that began with his trade request. Instead they won six straight, and after Thursday's 4-3 overtime win over the Islanders they're 7-3-0 in their last ten and 11-9-3 overall.

Dawson Mercer, part of the return from the Devils, has fit right in: 7 points in his last 10 games, a bit above the 5.3 his chances suggest. Mark Scheifele has been rewriting the franchise record book, and Kyle Connor reached 700 career points. Their line with Cole Perfetti carries the offence and wins its minutes 9-6.

The season-long picture is more modest. Winnipeg has had 48% of the expected goals, the quality of chances, and has given up 77 goals against 70 scored. Our numbers say the record is close to what the play deserves, and their playoff chances sit around 31% in a crowded Central. Special teams are a wash, the power play creating about as much as the penalty kill gives up.

What to watch: whether the goaltending without Hellebuyck can hold up against better teams, and whether the depth lines, outside the Adam Lowry, Alex Iafallo and Isak Rosen group, can tilt the ice. The win streak was fun. The shot share says they're still a bubble team.
headline: Life after Hellebuyck is going fine
